honest_framing_declared.statement: A3's before-figure is production; its after-figure is NOT, and is labelled at three distinct strengths rather than presented as one number.
honest_framing_declared.why: The packet's first report read '2/10' off its own test's dict while the same execute_run logged 10 failed/blocked, because the fake cursor never answered the reconcile query. The corrected figures below separate what was measured in production, what is counterfactually derivable from a real run's own frozen manifest, and what is only a unit-level reconstruction.

before_production_measured.blast_radius: all 8 runs lost 100% of their plan
before_production_measured.family_B_not_fixed: 7 records / 6 runs - still aborts in full; there is no manifest to react to

worst_case_run.correction: started_at is NULL on all 10 - not '0 completed' but 0 ever STARTED

after_production.why: no real divergence has occurred post-deploy, and manufacturing one would mean running a production build purely to produce a flattering figure
after_production.when_it_becomes_measurable: on the first genuine registry divergence after this lands

after_counterfactual_on_the_real_run.strength: strongest available - derived from the real run's own frozen manifest, not from a test
after_counterfactual_on_the_real_run.finding: no asset in d4a6dae2's plan depends on bg_yogas
after_counterfactual_on_the_real_run.result: A3 would have narrowed it from 10/10 aborted to 1/10 failed - 9 of 10 writers executing
after_counterfactual_on_the_real_run.other_family_A_run: ce114909 (mi_kula) had a 1-asset plan: 1/1 -> 1/1, no improvement possible
after_counterfactual_on_the_real_run.stated_limit: HEAD raised on the FIRST mismatch, so the record cannot say whether bg_yogas was the only diverged asset. If k diverged the figure is k/10, 1 <= k <= 10. That the number is unknowable is itself the defect Decision 4 fixes.

after_unit_level_reconstruction.strength: weakest - synthetic plan, mocked DB, one modelled dependent; NOT a measurement
after_unit_level_reconstruction.result: 8 of 10 writers dispatch and complete, 2 fail, and the run still correctly reports failed

scope_correction_carried_into_the_report.statement: A3 fixes 2 of the 8 runs in the headline family, not 8.
scope_correction_carried_into_the_report.detail: The '18 records / 8 runs' headline covers two unrelated defects sharing one error prefix. Family B - 6 of the 8 runs - is one-off dispatch scripts inserting build_runs with no plan_manifest at all. A3 cannot touch it; it is carried as A3b.

n8_detector.claim: narrowing suppresses blast radius, never detection
n8_detector.proof: a genuinely diverged asset (scope flipped per_chart -> global) still fails: state='error', writer never invoked
n8_detector.mutation_evidence: forcing the detector to return {} fails 6 tests; removing seed_failed's exclusion from pending returns the run to 10 failed/blocked; removing the has_cowriters comparison term now fails (it left 32/32 green before F-2)

opposing_direction_errors_reported_toget.note: These two lie in OPPOSITE directions and are reported as a pair so neither reads as an isolated slip.
opposing_direction_errors_reported_toget.under_recording_G1: the orphan-cleanup UPDATEs at runner.py:1293-1319 sit between the F-1 except (ends 1292) and the main try (starts 1320), guarded by neither. A fault there loses the divergence, exactly as before F-1. NOT charged against A3 - the correction's boundary was specified as ending at the claim, and the implementer built exactly that. Bound to the next packet touching execute_run's pre-dispatch path.
opposing_direction_errors_reported_toget.over_recording_F5: A3 writes asset_throughput where HEAD wrote nothing, so a transient false positive can downgrade a possibly-lit asset and overwrite last_built_at. F-1 WIDENED this: the write now occurs on 'claim succeeded OR hard fault after detection' rather than 'claim succeeded'. Bounded by a measured self-heal - fault writes error, divergence resolves, retry takes both rows to complete and the run reports completed.
opposing_direction_errors_reported_toget.honest_summary: F-1 narrowed A3's own loss window and widened its write surface. 'Disjoint, therefore unchanged' would be half the picture.
